::: {#exm-weakly-connected}
#### The steps of a software project

A project moves between four steps: plan, code, test and ship.
The directed graph with these steps as vertices has the four edges

$$
(\text{plan}, \text{code}), \quad (\text{code}, \text{test}), \quad (\text{test}, \text{code}), \quad (\text{test}, \text{ship}),
$$

since after testing, the team either fixes the code or ships.
It is weakly connected (@def-weakly-connected):
ignoring the directions, the walk plan, code, test, ship visits every vertex,
and the part of it between any two vertices, read in one direction or the other, is a walk between them.
It is not strongly connected (@def-strongly-connected),
since no edge starts at ship, so there is no walk from ship to any other step.

:::
